# MarketScope

> MarketScope turns your project inputs into a structured, lender-ready market analysis — demographics, demand, comps, absorption — and folds in your CapStack capital stack with one pasted link.

MarketScope is a free web tool at https://marketscope.nesohq.com/. It runs in the browser with no account.
It is for developers and sponsors who need market context for a lender.

## Questions MarketScope answers

- **What does a lender-ready market study include?** Trade-area definition, demographics and growth, demand derivation, a comparable set with rents or prices, absorption, and a stated conclusion about depth of demand.
- **What is absorption and how is it calculated?** Absorption is the rate at which units or space are taken up by the market, usually expressed per month.
- **How many comparables does a market study need?** Enough to establish a range rather than a point — commonly six to ten genuinely competitive properties, chosen for overlap in tenant, price band and location rather than convenience.
- **Do I need an appraisal or a market study?** They answer different questions.

## Use it

- [Open MarketScope](https://marketscope.nesohq.com/)
